notes.title: Dungeon Rampage Demo & Kickstarter Aftermath!
notes.content:
[h1]THANK YOU, RAMPAGERS!!![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060016/96ab253c02fe943b40378f46e7dd1a418a7a385e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce we’ve officially smashed through our Kickstarter funding goal!! With [u][b]$70,463[/b][/u] raised by over [u][b]1,600[/b][/u] mighty backers, you’ve made it loud and clear that you’re ready to pledge your warrior’s honor for a revived and restored Dungeon Rampage.[/p][p]But that’s not all! Alongside our Kickstarter success, you also flooded our Steam demo and proved to us in numbers how much you love this game. At almost [b]100k[/b] players, with over [u][b]1000[/b][/u] reviews and a [u][b]97% Overwhelmingly Positive rating[/b][/u], you did more than bring this game back from the dead… You chucked evil lord Dingplepus down into the moat, sank him with a boulder and propped Dungeon Rampage on his gilded throne for all to see.[/p][p]This was just a quick numbers recap to show you how far we’ve come and what you were able to accomplish. From now on, you might not hear from us for a while as we refocus on finishing up the game. But fear not! We’ll check in with real updates when we have progress worth sharing.[/p][p]
Thanks again for your patience and see you soonish,[/p][p]– The Dungeon Rampage Team[/p][p]PS: We have updated our Steam art & description, hope you like the new look![/p]
